what: Known vulnerabilities pip-audit is told to accept in CI (backlog item 11). Every other finding fails the build, with or without a fix. Each entry gives the reason and when to look again.

accepted.reason: flwr 1.39.0 (the 'federated' extra, used only to train and rerun the federated research results) requires cryptography>=46.0.7,<47. flwr 1.43.0 allows 50.x, but upgrading flwr changes the stack behind committed federated results, which is the owner's call. cryptography is not installed in the API image (the 'api' extra); the Trivy scan of that image is separate.
accepted.accepted_by: Claude, overnight run; confirmed by the owner on 2026-11-09 (flwr not upgraded)

accepted.reason: flwr 1.39.0 (the 'federated' extra, training only) requires uv>=0.11.15,<0.12; the same flwr upgrade decision as the cryptography entry. uv is not in the API image. Found by the first CI run of this audit (2026-11-09).
accepted.accepted_by: Claude, overnight run; confirmed by the owner on 2026-11-09 (flwr not upgraded)
